changelog:
- Improved setup instructions for connecting and verifying PatSnap Life Science MCP services.
- Enforced a mandatory connectivity check to MCP services before processing user queries, with clear error guidance if services are not connected.
- Enhanced guidance on typical disease investigation queries and clarified analysis workflow paths (pathology, epidemiology, treatment, pipeline, patents, and commercial strategy).
- Expanded and clarified principles for data retrieval, search strategies, and tool usage to ensure reliable and precise information sourcing.
- Updated terminology and best practices for use by life sciences R&D and business development professionals.
summary: Conduct comprehensive disease investigation combining academic literature, epidemiological data, clinical guidelines, pharmaceutical intelligence, and clinical trial reports. Users may inquire about disease pathogenesis, symptoms, pharmaceutical interventions, treatment options, patent landscapes, and business development opportunities. Load the skill when queries involve: - Disease pathology and molecular mechanisms - Regional disease incidence and subtypes - Clinical symptoms and diagnostic indicators - Treatment landscape and drug development pipeline - Patent and IP analysis for therapeutic areas - Business development and deal intelligence Typical queries - Pathogenesis of NSCLC - Treatment options for influenza - Incidence rates of leukemia in China - Clinical manifestations of depression - PD-1/PD-L1 patent landscape - Drug development pipeline for NSCLC
